findings.title: Mach-O Binary Unencrypted (cryptid = 0) [ARM64]
findings.evidence: LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO cryptid=0 (expected for ad-hoc/enterprise builds; App Store builds must be 1).
findings.remediation: Verify FairPlay DRM encryption is active on the final App Store Connect build.

findings.title: Insecure C String / Memory or Weak PRNG Functions Imported [ARM64]
findings.evidence: _memcpy (Potential heap/stack buffer overflow if length is unchecked -> use memcpy_s / bounds-checked copy); _random (Predictable PRNG unsuitable for security -> use SecRandomCopyBytes); _strcpy (Buffer overflow risk (no bounds checking) -> use strlcpy / strncpy)
findings.remediation: Replace unsafe C functions with bounded alternatives (strlcpy, snprintf) and use SecRandomCopyBytes() for cryptographic randomness.

findings.title: Weak Cryptographic Algorithms or Cipher Modes Detected [ARM64]
findings.evidence: CC_MD5: MD5 is cryptographically broken (collision attacks) (Use SHA-256 / SHA-3 via CryptoKit); CC_SHA1: SHA-1 is deprecated and vulnerable to collisions (Use SHA-256 / SHA-3 via CryptoKit)
findings.remediation: Migrate CommonCrypto implementations to Apple CryptoKit using SHA-256/SHA-3 and AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305.

findings.title: App Transport Security (ATS) Globally Disabled
findings.evidence: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads = true (permits cleartext HTTP connections to any domain).
findings.remediation: Remove NSAllowsArbitraryLoads (or set to false) and enforce HTTPS with TLS 1.2+ across all backend endpoints.

findings.title: Custom URL Schemes Exposed (Deep Link Hijacking Surface)
findings.remediation: Migrate authentication callbacks and sensitive deep links to Universal Links (associated-domains) and strictly sanitize URL parameters.

findings.title: Sensitive Device Privacy Permissions Declared
findings.evidence: Declared permissions: Camera (NSCameraUsageDescription), Face ID Biometrics (NSFaceIDUsageDescription)
findings.remediation: Verify that every declared usage description corresponds to an active, user-facing feature.

findings.title: Debuggable Entitlement Enabled (get-task-allow = true)
findings.evidence: get-task-allow = true (allows debugger attachment and container inspection on non-jailbroken devices).
findings.remediation: Sign release builds with an App Store or Enterprise Production Distribution profile where get-task-allow is false.

findings.title: High-Entropy String (Potential Embedded Secret)
findings.remediation: Audit the flagged string and externalize any cryptographic secrets or API tokens from client-side bundle assets.
